scheme_name: The West Bengal Incentive Scheme: Subsidy for Quality Improvement
other_conditions: Applicable to tourism projects/units/expansion projects of existing units set up on or after 22 February 2021
Applicable to hotel units that started commercial operation between 7 January 2015 and 31 December 2020 and were unable to apply earlier due to absence of a Bar in the hotel
Units may belong to private, co‑operative, joint sectors or be owned/managed by the State Government
Project must be supported by a detailed feasibility report prepared for the purpose
Project must be approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, Commercial Bank or State Financial Institution
Unit must hold a Registration Certificate, Date of Commencement Certificate and Eligibility Certificate issued by the West Bengal Tourism Development Corporation Limited
benefits_summary: Subsidy of up to 50% of the fixed capital investment, capped at ₹7,50,000.
